|game_text=Deploy on table. When [[Luke (V){{!}}Luke]] deploys using your Objective, he deploys to Vader's site (if possible). Duels initiated with your Objective may not be canceled. Once per game, may ▲ [[Rise, My Friend]]. If this Effect canceled by opponent, stack it on [[Insignificant Rebellion]].
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3 of [[So Be It, Jedi]] (version 4 of 4); it is the current text. The image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1262-11-front-master.png]]), which prints this text. Versions in date order: [[So Be It, Jedi]] (original, release sheet of 7 December 2009); [[So Be It, Jedi (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[So Be It, Jedi (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); '''this page''' (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[So Be It, Jedi]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 6.2 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploy on table. When Luke deploys using your Objective, he deploys to Vader’s site (if possible). Duels initiated with your Objective may not be canceled. Once per game, may ▲ Rise, My Friend. If this Effect canceled by opponent, stack it on Insignificant Rebellion.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_2.pdf#page=3 Virtual Block 6.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 3, slip 211. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_2.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Dark Side, p. 31). Under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 (this page), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=31, page 31. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=31 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “2 • 11” at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[So Be It, Jedi (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 12 December 2012) changed “Luke deploys” to “Luke dpeloys” (typo as published; the card list writes the ▲ icon out): “Deploy on table. When Luke dpeloys using your Objective, he deploys to Vader's site (if possible). Duels initiated with your Objective may not be canceled. Once per game, may take Rise, My Friend into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If this Effect canceled by opponent, stack it on Insignificant Rebellion.”.<ref name="cl-1262_11-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[So Be It, Jedi (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-sobeitjedi-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[So Be It, Jedi]]) again, word for word: “Deploy on table. When Luke deploys using your Objective, he deploys to Vader’s site (if possible). Duels initiated with your Objective may not be canceled. Once per game, may ▲ Rise, My Friend. If this Effect canceled by opponent, stack it on Insignificant Rebellion.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual6-Dark card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual6-Dark">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034706/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints the slip number “2 • 11” at the bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 31)<ref name="ml-ds" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[So Be It, Jedi]]) again, word for word: “Deploy on table. When Luke deploys using your Objective, he deploys to Vader’s site (if possible). Duels initiated with your Objective may not be canceled. Once per game, may ▲ Rise, My Friend. If this Effect canceled by opponent, stack it on Insignificant Rebellion.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1262-11-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image print “2 • 11”).
